name: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa
positioning: A large Texas Hill Country resort near San Antonio with a nine-acre water park, two championship golf courses and Lantana Spa
best_for: Families who want a resort water park with a lazy river and slides
Golfers who want to play the TPC San Antonio courses
Couples looking for a Hill Country spa stay

facts.text: The resort sits amid 600 acres of oak-covered hills in the Texas Hill Country near San Antonio.
Resort guests have exclusive access to the River Bluff Water Experience, a nine-acre water park with water slides.
The water park includes an activity pool, waterfalls, a 1,100-foot lazy river and a 650-foot action river ride.
The water park has a Sand Beach Pool where guests can build sandcastles.
TPC San Antonio has two 18-hole championship golf courses designed by Pete Dye and Greg Norman.
Lantana Spa offers massage, beauty and wellness therapies inspired by the traditions of Latin American Curanderos.
Lantana Spa has a private, lagoon-like pool, a spa cafe and a spa boutique.
Select rooms have private Juliet or walkout balconies with views of the rolling hills.
The Golf View Suites have oversized balconies overlooking the TPC San Antonio golf courses.
18 Oaks is the resort's signature steakhouse, rooted in the flavors of Texas.
A self-guided art tour highlights artists of Texas and the wider United States.
Natural Bridge Caverns, Six Flags Fiesta Texas and Texas wine country are within an hour's drive.

highlights.text: The Oaks course has hosted the PGA Tour's Valero Texas Open since 2010.
Lantana Spa guests receive a red ribbon on arrival as part of the Seven Knots Ritual to release worries and stress.
The water park has an infinity pool for adults overlooking the Texas Hill Country.
The Grand River Suites incorporate the style of the San Antonio haciendas that grew into Texas ranches.
Each Grand River Suite has a fireplace, a library and a dining room that seats up to 8.

considerations.text: The resort is 14 miles northeast of San Antonio International Airport.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for luxury amenities and services.
